aislinn_gifts.anchor: Aislinn cannot use ordinary region trading
aislinn_gifts.source_fact: Aislinn gifts settlements to six playable High Elf factions and cannot trade regions normally.

arkhan_living.source_fact: Arkhan has a distinct Vampiric Undead affinity rather than the ordinary Tomb King relationship pattern.

arkhan_tombs.source_fact: Arkhan starts at -60 Tomb King and +40 Vampiric Undead relations.

arkhan_vampires.source_fact: Arkhan starts with +40 Vampiric Undead relations.

azazel_humans.source_fact: Azazel has +80 relations with Empire/Kislev/Cathay/Bretonnia; seduction excludes human targets.

beastmen_0.source_fact: Restricted treaty set; permitted-faction membership and teammate bypass are not enumerated by the guide; positive deals reduce Bestial Rage for five turns.

bretonnia_0.source_fact: Human confederation cooldown exemption is not permission to absorb a human teammate.

changeling_schemes.anchor: Grand Scheme completion applies a theatre-specific
changeling_schemes.source_fact: Schemes make theater-specific world changes and rifts have scripted progression.

chaos_dwarfs_0.source_fact: Tower-seat usurpation causes a five-turn diplomatic penalty; coordinate seat claims.

daemons_of_chaos_0.source_fact: Guide establishes no bespoke diplomacy override; generic aversion and dedication-state modifiers remain unmeasured.

dark_elves_0.source_fact: Har Ganeth Blood Voyage is a forced vassal targeting occupied Ulthuan settlements; not a general alliance ban.

dark_elves_1.source_fact: Hag Graef gains conditional +25/+50 daemon relations at high possession; not a permanent faction-wide alliance guarantee.

dwarfs_0.source_fact: Grudge accumulation responds to hostile conduct; positive diplomacy reduces it.

dwarfs_1.anchor: A region adjacent to territory owned
dwarfs_1.source_fact: Different allied Dwarf owners can enable conditional Deeps trade/diplomacy benefits.

empire_0.source_fact: Reikland Elector politics replaces ordinary confederation/NAP paths; does not establish a general military-alliance ban.

epidemius_plagues.anchor: The installed script applies no diplomacy test
epidemius_plagues.source_fact: Non-Nurgle allies can count in the negative-plague Tally.

eshin_contracts.anchor: It also unlocks diplomacy with a positively regarded issuing clan
eshin_contracts.source_fact: Greater Clan Contracts change issuer/target standing and unlock positive-clan diplomacy; Anarchy excludes humans.

golgfag_contracts.anchor: The Maneaters cannot conclude military alliances
golgfag_contracts.source_fact: Maneaters cannot make military/defensive alliances or vassal agreements; client offers exclude enemies of his team.

grand_cathay_0.anchor: no distinct Grand Cathay campaign rule was found
grand_cathay_0.source_fact: Guide found no distinct diplomatic replacement; generic faction modifiers remain outside coverage.

greenskins_0.source_fact: Leader-defeat confederation requires an AI loser; it cannot consume the human teammate.

high_elves_0.source_fact: Eataine can unlock Champion actions through alliances with other legendary High Elf factions.

huntsmarshal_lizards.source_fact: Lizardmen diplomacy disabled except payments/war/peace, with explicit teammate exception.

kemmler_chaos.anchor: diplomacy is +30 with Warriors of Chaos
kemmler_chaos.source_fact: Kemmler has +30 WoC/Beastmen/Norsca diplomacy and Chaos attrition immunity.

khalida_lahmia.anchor: permanently unable to make peace with the Lahmian Sisterhood
khalida_lahmia.source_fact: Khalida has permanent no-peace with the nonplayable Lahmian Sisterhood.

khorne_0.source_fact: No bespoke diplomacy override established; absence does not imply zero generic aversion.

kislev_0.source_fact: Old supporter-race forced confederation and intra-Kislev war ban are obsolete; ordinary diplomacy applies.

lizardmen_0.source_fact: Allied province capitals support the Geomantic Web; Nakai and Oxyotl use documented variants.

nakai_vassal.anchor: outside factions cannot independently declare war or peace
nakai_vassal.source_fact: Defenders forced vassal has locked war/peace and cannot break from Nakai.

norsca_0.source_fact: Leader-defeat tribal confederation is not an ordinary alliance restriction; human-target applicability is not proven here.

nurgle_0.anchor: The installed script applies no diplomacy test
nurgle_0.source_fact: Epidemius can count negatively plagued non-Nurgle allies; alliance status provides no documented protection.

ogre_kingdoms_0.anchor: all Ogre Kingdoms factions are immune
ogre_kingdoms_0.source_fact: Ogre trespass diplomacy immunity is official-source-only in the guide; battle confederation requires an AI loser.

repanse_undead.source_fact: Repanse has -80 relations with all three undead races.

sayl_treaties.anchor: the automatic below-zero war listener is inert
sayl_treaties.source_fact: Sayl Manipulations alter treaties; automatic below-zero Confidence war listener is inert in 8.1.1.

settra_vassal.anchor: Khemri cannot be made anyone's vassal
settra_vassal.source_fact: All vassal actions against Khemri are disabled.

skaven_0.anchor: when the factions are not teammates
skaven_0.source_fact: Vermintide war declaration explicitly excludes teammates; this is not blanket protection against all Under-City damage.

slaanesh_0.anchor: The ritual target explicitly excludes human factions
slaanesh_0.source_fact: N'Kari forced seduction cannot target humans; this does not make third-party vassal diplomacy harmless.

tomb_kings_0.anchor: When another relevant Tomb Kings faction is human
tomb_kings_0.source_fact: Human participants lock Cult confederation rituals.

tomb_kings_1.anchor: the same mission key fails for every other eligible human
tomb_kings_1.source_fact: Books of Nagash are competitive shared multiplayer rewards; team ownership does not duplicate them.

tzeentch_0.anchor: Grand Scheme completion applies a theatre-specific
tzeentch_0.source_fact: Changeling Schemes change the world by theater; effects on a partner require coordination, not a universal immunity assumption.

vampire_coast_0.source_fact: Coast cannot confederate; alliances can transfer Shanty verses.

vampire_counts_0.anchor: diplomacy is +30 with Warriors of Chaos
vampire_counts_0.source_fact: Barrow Legion has +30 WoC/Beastmen/Norsca relations and faction Chaos-attrition immunity.

warriors_of_chaos_0.anchor: It does not prove that every destroyed
warriors_of_chaos_0.source_fact: Homeland vassalization is faction/settlement-specific and does not guarantee revival.

warriors_of_chaos_1.anchor: Only **Warhost of the Apocalypse and Shadow Legion**
warriors_of_chaos_1.source_fact: Only Archaon/Be'lakor have the final-settlement forced WoC confederation route; other WoC do not.

wood_elves_0.anchor: locks that specific rite for every human Wood Elf faction
wood_elves_0.source_fact: Rebirth completion is global and one-time in co-op; Ariel is globally unique.

wood_elves_1.anchor: she is barred from confederating Wood Elves generally
wood_elves_1.source_fact: Drycha can confederate only Argwylon; not a general ban on Wood Elf alliances.
